description: Free preview of the paid tool: give one question and one public URL and get back up to three cited excerpts with the source URL, retrieval time and content hash. No assessment and no verdict - that is what research_evidence adds, over up to five sources. Capped per day. Use this to judge whether the paid call is worth 0.01 USDC.

question.description: The question or claim to gather web evidence for.

url.description: One public source URL to retrieve and cite. The paid tool accepts up to five.
